creator.description:
Labels accounts that have published valid com.atproto.lexicon.schema records.

Valid = DNS authority proven via _lexicon.<authority> TXT, and the schema passes lex-lint.

locales.description: This account has published one or more com.atproto.lexicon.schema records that pass two checks: (1) DNS-level proof of authority over the NSID's domain, via a _lexicon.<authority> TXT record advertising the publisher's DID; and (2) the in-tree lex-lint, validating that the schema is structurally well-formed.
locales.name: Verified Lexicon Publisher

locales.description: This account controls the DNS zone of a domain whose _lexicon.<authority> TXT advertises a verified lexicon publisher under a DIFFERENT DID. Evidence is the _atproto.<authority> TXT (or .well-known) at the same apex. Does NOT mean endorsement: a domain operator and a lexicon publisher can be different entities even when they share infrastructure.
locales.name: Lexicon Domain Operator
